race.description: Adelaide Hotel Showcase Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: COCO DIOR (5) is the clear starting point after having excuses first-up at Illawarra Grange, where she was beaten just over two lengths after striking trouble in the straight. She's fitter for that effort and has plenty of upside and scope for improvement. JVO sticks and she can notch up her maiden victory. CHEEKY SORT (4) was held up two back at Wyong, before a solid effort here last time out. Strips fitter third-up and the rise in trip looks to suit. Can feature. PONZI SCHEME (12) finds a suitable race now after a plain effort first-up at Kembla. Expecting him to be better for that run and can build on that performance. SILVERWATER KID (3) wasn't far away at Illawarra Grange last time out and comes back to country level now. Include.
